definition: to push a baby out of your body
description: A young woman in a dark sports top kneels in warm water in a blue inflatable birth pool in a softly lit living room at night, with candles on the mantelpiece and fairy lights along the curtains. Her eyes are shut and her face is tense as she holds hands tightly with a man in a grey T-shirt kneeling outside the pool, their foreheads together. He then lifts his head and speaks to her. A midwife in navy scrubs holds a torch beside them, and a birthing ball, blankets on the sofa and an open medical kit are behind.

en.question: What is the pregnant woman doing?

es.answer: Está arrodillada en una piscina de partos.

fr.answer: Elle est à genoux dans une piscine d'accouchement.
